path_base: This JSON directory; source paths are relative to portfolio.curated.json.
method: Visual inspection of current local captures and source provenance, then editorial App Store positioning. No measured keyword volume, search ranks, conversion lift or live listing claims.
criteria: Lead with completed work or a populated result.
Include a category-intent noun so benefit is clear without knowing the name.
Reject setup/warning/blank/disconnected states as first image.
Preserve exact UI, use explicit source crop only.
Never nest an existing marketing device frame in another frame.

apps.name: Nodex
apps.positioning: Inspect Linux health, metrics history, systemd and Docker over direct SSH.

selected.rationale: Lead with populated metric trends. The overview, network and services captures show a sudo setup prompt; history explains the value immediately.
Show actual container groups and running/stopped states as supporting evidence of Docker monitoring.

apps.name: Termex
apps.positioning: SSH terminals, host-side tmux continuity and native SFTP.

selected.rationale: An explicit feature excerpt shows active and verified SFTP rows. The full source also includes a failed transfer; this crop illustrates one feature, with demo data disclosed. A connected terminal capture is still needed.

rejected_leads: Terminal lead: almost blank and explicitly simulated, no live connection.
Settings lead: preference controls do not demonstrate working benefit.
capture_gaps: No persuasive real terminal or running tmux screenshot in current set.
Sample SFTP transfer is only 37 bytes; no speed/scale claim.
Existing full transfer scene includes failed.tar/network lost. Crop does not alter UI state.

apps.name: Codexex
apps.positioning: Reported Codex allowance and reset timing with iPhone Live Activity.

selected.rationale: The large reset clock and remaining allowance explain the product at a glance. Keep the sample-data disclosure from the original screenshot-set design.
A declared crop enlarges the complete original chart card instead of shrinking a mostly empty screen. The UI data and plotted marks remain unchanged.

rejected_leads: Live Activity lead: wallpaper dominates a small actual usage pill.
capture_gaps: Say reported allowance; do not imply guaranteed quota, increased allowance or control of resets.
Scene names plus/pro are existing capture names, not a promise every account reports both windows.

Raw iPhone images are 1320x2868; iPad images are 2064x2752. Captures are AppStore native preview data, not the Matrix HTML prototype.

apps.name: Tesatlas
apps.positioning: Explore TeslaMate/MyTeslaMate drive, charging and energy records locally.

selected.rationale: Use the current renamed 6.5.1 build 35 capture. The route map, distance, energy and recorded cost tell a clearer story than capacity tiles. Crop removes existing marketing captions and keeps the full native viewport.
Multiple routes and period totals extend the story from one drive to a useful history. Retain the full native viewport.

apps.name: Tescam
apps.positioning: Review synchronised Tesla dashcam views, select range and export locally.

selected.rationale: The exact camera-selection and codec/export controls make a useful feature image. Existing near-white synthetic camera tiles are weak proof of playback; capture meaningful footage before a footage-led campaign.

rejected_leads: Overview/playback hero: pale synthetic six-camera tiles look like blank placeholders.
capture_gaps: Provenance declares synthetic demo footage, not user footage.
Needs a meaningful real or clearly labelled demo capture for footage-led marketing.
Existing phone images already include captions/device framing; prefer raw capture or preserve complete composition.
